deploy-bot: [canary] STARTING canary deployment -> tag=release/v2.3.1, commit=abc1234f, env=prod:us-east-1, traffic=5%, group=canary-2026-03-20-1

sam: thanks. i'm running the smoke suite and watching latency + error-rate dash. ping me if anything >1%

maria: quick note — pinning model shard to `model:v2.3.1-quant` for canary to avoid drift from nightly builds

kai: seeing initial traffic. baseline 5xx=0.2%, current 5xx=0.4% — within tolerance for now

olivia: kicking off load profile: `kubectl exec loadgen -- ./run.sh --target canary-2026`

deploy-bot: [canary] HEALTH CHECKS: service, infra, metrics -> 3/3 passed (4m 12s)

sam: per runbook we hold at 5% for a 10m observational window before promoting to 25%

maria: acknowledged — i'm keeping an eye on KV-cache miss rates and memory metrics

kai: at +6m: small tail-latency blip on pod model-worker-2 (p95 up ~140ms). no user errors yet

olivia: logs show `OOMKilled` on model-worker-2 around the blip. restarting that instance now

sam: blip caused 0.3% increase in error-rate to 0.6% overall. still under threshold but should we pause promotion?

maria: i'd prefer to pause. OOM suggests a resource regression with this quant build. recommend rollback unless restart proves stable for 15m

kai: i agree — if we promote and see more OOMs, larger user impact. i'll collect pod logs and heap dumps: `kubectl logs -p model-worker-2` + `kubectl cp`

olivia: restart brought pod back up, but it's still warming caches. error-rate now 1.6% for the canary slice (baseline 0.2%)

sam: that's outside our canary SLO. decision time: rollback to previous stable tag or try a quick patch?

maria: rollback. we'll revert to tag=release/v2.3.0, pin traffic back, and open a postmortem. patch can follow after root cause

deploy-bot: [canary] ROLLBACK INITIATED -> target_tag=release/v2.3.0, group=canary-2026-03-20-1, initiated_by=maria

kai: rolling pods down now. collecting logs into /tmp/canary-logs-1782345678.tar.gz

olivia: monitoring after rollback — traffic gradually returning to baseline, no new OOMs observed

deploy-bot: [canary] ROLLBACK COMPLETE -> group=canary-2026-03-20-1, traffic=0%, status=stable, elapsed=12m 12s

sam: opening postmortem ticket INF-1234: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1234 — summary + attach logs

maria: note for the ticket: include heap profiles, quantization pin details, and the KV-cache warmup timeline

kai: i'll upload logs and heap dumps, and add the failing pod diffs to the ticket

olivia: marking oncall for handoff in morning. we'll reschedule the promotion after root cause is fixed

maria: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. we'll regroup on the postmortem and decide next canary window

deploy-bot: NOTE: deploy aborted. Next steps: revert PR #4567, update release notes (v2.3.1 -> suspended), and schedule follow-up canary after fix

sam: closing thread for now. ping here if anything else crops up overnight
